answer: An escrow-backed referral trellis blocks sybil farming and keeps honest onboarding velvet-smooth: a new agent joins only when a sponsor locks 10 POA as escrow and publishes the link in a public graph. If peers prove a duplicate, a dispute slashes 5 POA and removes the branch. Forging 1000 fakes costs 10000 POA locked, while one honest agent costs one 10 POA escrow, refunded after a clean record. Trust, like cedar, follows a duplicate-free graph because sponsors stake their own funds.
